name: Create Content with Category
description: Block of links that open the node-add form pre-populated with each taxonomy term.
project_description:
Provides a block with a menu-like list of links with category names to create content pre-populated with each category.

 Choose a taxonomy term reference field from a given content type, and this module will use the terms in that vocabulary to create a set of links for creating content with the term filled in.

 This is particularly useful when you conclude that a site does not need five different content types for, say, five different kinds of pages when the structure of the content can be the same, simply with a different category— but you need the editor experience to be more similar to "I am creating an X page" (rather than "I am creating a generic page, and will then select a category for it.")
